target.name: Bored pile wall, overlapped, strutted apart, Alterssiedlung Seefeldstrasse Zürich

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tab. 6.6 'Sachbilanzdaten zur Herstellung der bilanzierten Bohrpfahlwände pro m2 Ansichtsfläche', first value column 'bored pile wall, overlapped, strutted apart, Alterssiedlung Seefeldstrasse Zürich' [CH], per 1 m2; allocation: none stated. A resource correction of 90 % of the gravel and sand content of the concrete is applied because the pile concrete is disposed of and recycled.. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2014 - LCA civil eng. works in building const. - Frischknecht.pdf

gaps_reported_by_model: No direct air emissions (dust, combustion emissions) are inventoried for the process itself; the diesel combustion is carried by the 'diesel, burned in building machine' dataset.
No disposal of the wall at end of life appears in the table, only the resource correction.

The two resource corrections in the table (-2.12E+3 kg gravel, -1.30E+3 kg sand) are about 11 and 19 % larger in magnitude than the ones visible in the aggregated vector (-1903 and -1070 kg), so the shipped dataset may use a slightly different concrete composition than this column.
skipped_items: concrete, concrete for underground construction, average cement Switzerland, at plant: ignore — 0 in this column: the low-cement underground-construction concrete is used only for the anchored wall (Stadtspital Triemli). The strutted wall uses the drilled-pile concrete instead.

concrete, concrete for drilled piles, average cement Switzerland, at plant: no dataset chosen (The keyword search returned no candidate at all for the drilled-pile concrete with average Swiss cement, so nothing can be chosen. This is the largest input of the process (4.92E+3 kg per m2) and is reported as missing.)
bored pile wall, overlapped, strutted apart, Alterssiedlung Seefeldstrasse Zürich: product — the reference product, 1 m2 of face area

inputs.note: the strutting ('Spriessung', diverse profiles); the non-anchored variant has 0 for this line because it needs no strutting

derivation.quote: technosphere       rolled steel, at regional storage                      CH            0                    kg        5.33E+1            2.13E+1              0                1               1.16                data; APT Ingenieure 2014, pers.
derivation.per: per m2 Ansichtsflaeche (face area) of bored pile wall

inputs.name: Steel, low alloyed, secondary production (100% Rec.)
inputs.note: every second pile is reinforced, per the database comment

derivation.quote: reinforcing steel, secondary production, (100% Rec.)   CH            0                    kg        6.40E+1            1.13E+2           6.40E+1             1               1.16                data; APT Ingenieure 2014, pers.
derivation.per: per m2 Ansichtsflaeche (face area) of bored pile wall
derivation.mapping_reason: The report states the 100 % recycled (secondary) route explicitly, which this candidate matches, whereas 'Reinforcing steel, primary production (0% Rec.)' is the opposite route; no 'reinforcing steel, secondary production' dataset appears among the candidates, so the product form (bar rather than unspecified low-alloyed steel) is the compromise.

inputs.name: Diesel, burned in building machine, average
inputs.note: the text gives 6 to 7 litres of diesel per metre of drilling depending on the bore diameter, and 6.5 l/m was used

derivation.quote: diesel, burned in building machine                     GLO           0                    MJ        1.81E+3            7.44E+2           1.81E+3             1               1.16                data; Marti AG, 2014, pers.
derivation.per: per m2 Ansichtsflaeche (face area) of bored pile wall
derivation.mapping_reason: The report names the plain 'diesel, burned in building machine' with no filter technology, so the 'average' dataset beats the with/without particle filter variants; the agricultural machine and concrete crusher datasets are different machinery and are measured per kilogram.

inputs.name: Transport, freight, lorry, 32t-40t gross weight, fleet average
inputs.note: standard distances ecoinvent v2.2: 20 km for concrete, 50 km for steel

derivation.quote: transport, lorry >28t, fleet average                   CH            0                    tkm       1.04E+2            7.11E+1           1.02E+2             1               2.03                concrete, 50 km for steel; standard
derivation.per: per m2 Ansichtsflaeche (face area) of bored pile wall
